referenceFunction.generalComment: Production of a ventilation system for a residential care home with apartments and multi-purpose hall. The inventory is based on a building with a total heated gross floor area of 3712 m2 and a total nominal air flow of 6000 m3/h, total weight of the components: 1674 kg/Unit, building with a specific air flow rate of 1.6 m3/h per m2 heated gross floor area. Data from call of bid including components for air handling units, ducts including insulation, air valves, roof-hoods, dampers, fire dampers, silencers. The data represent a ductwork made of galvanized steel and polyethylene tubes. It includes air handling units mainly with heat recovery. System with central air handling units. Building without ground heat exchanger.; UUID: 8da9da50-2638-3611-8cc0-2962daa7c170
